# Steady: Sobriety & Habit Tracker

> Steady is a private, on-device sobriety and habit tracker for iOS and Android. It runs a live sobriety clock, takes a daily check-in, tracks money saved, and keeps a mood and craving journal. There is no account, no ads, no social feed and no server: everything stays on the user's phone unless they turn on encrypted backup to their own iCloud or Google Drive. It is free to start; a one-time Premium purchase of $19.99 USD (no subscription) unlocks everything.

Steady is not a medical service and does not give medical advice. Insights describe patterns in what the user has logged.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS and Android
- Category: Health and wellness (sobriety, habit tracking)
- Account required: No. No sign-up, email address or login.
- Data storage: On the user's device. Steady has no server or database holding user data.
- Backup: Optional, Premium. Encrypted on the device before upload to the user's own iCloud or Google Drive.
- Pricing: Free to start. Premium is a one-time lifetime unlock for $19.99 USD (US price), no subscription.
- Free: sobriety clock, daily check-ins, money saved, milestone reminders, journal, dark mode, one habit
- Premium: multiple habits, full history and streaks, Insights (mood, craving and trigger patterns), accent themes, encrypted cloud backup
- Data control: Users can export a plain-text copy of everything they've logged and delete all data permanently from within the app.
- Support: steady-support@lixlink.com
